''See also: [[Teranon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Teranon is a seasoned [[Archmage]] and an elderly [[half-Aethril]], characterized by wrinkled skin with a subtle blue tint and gray hair containing star-like sparkles. He has served as a mentor to [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]] for many years and has maintained a long-standing professional relationship with the [[Vallenar Corporation]]. As a senior figure, he possesses significant [[Authority|authority]] and experience, though he has expressed concerns regarding the dangers of certain magical developments. His magical capabilities include the use of telekinesis, divination, and specialized vision spells involving [[Aetheric symbols]] or magical lenses. Throughout his duties, he has been involved in investigating mysterious origins, managing magical preparations for teams, and addressing serious breaches of treaty involving [[World Spirits]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Teranon is a visibly aged [[half-Aethril]]. His gray hair contains lights that sparkle like stars.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a wise man and longtime [[Archmage]], Teranon serves as an expert advisor and friend to [[Benri Vallenar]]. He has acted as a mentor to [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]] and is a member of [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]]'s team, though he does not hold a leadership role.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Teranon serves as an advisor, teammate, and friend to [[Benri Vallenar]]. He also acted as one of [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]]'s magical mentors and provided him with a spell. Additionally, Teranon has interacted with [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Teranon utilizes analysis spells to perform his work. He is capable of manifesting an orange-ish [[magic circle]] over his eye to examine data.}}
